name: bom-declaration-trap
title: The likeliest way to write .dove/mode.json on Windows breaks it
description: Measured: PowerShell 5.1 Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 writes ef bb bf, JSON.parse rejects the BOM, and the product correctly reads the declaration as exists-but-unreadable. The schema was right. The trap is that the most natural command on this platform produces a file the product cannot read.
creator: aixi
